items.prompt: In art class we learned this rule: if you mix blue and yellow, you ___ green.
items.audioText: In art class we learned this rule: if you mix blue and yellow, you get green.

feedback.he: would מתאים למצב דמיוני. כאן זו עובדה שתמיד נכונה.
feedback.en: would is for imaginary situations. This is a fact that is always true.

feedback.he: got זה עבר. הכלל נכון תמיד, לכן הווה.
feedback.en: got is past. A rule is always true, so use the present.

feedback.he: getting לבד הוא לא פועל שלם.
feedback.en: getting alone is not a full verb.

hints.he: זה כלל שתמיד נכון, או דמיון?
hints.en: Is this a rule that is always true, or imagination?

hints.he: עובדה קבועה: if + הווה, ובחלק השני גם הווה.
hints.en: A fixed fact: if + present, and present in the other part too.

explanation.he: עובדות וכללים שתמיד נכונים בונים עם הווה פשוט בשני החלקים (Zero Conditional): if you mix, you get. בעברית אומרים 'מקבלים', וגם באנגלית משתמשים בהווה.
explanation.en: Facts and rules that are always true use the present simple in both parts (zero conditional): if you mix, you get.

items.prompt: איזה משפט מדבר על מצב בעבר שלא קרה, ושכבר אי אפשר לשנות?

options.text: If Noa had won the scholarship, she would have studied in Haifa.
If Noa wins the scholarship, she will study in Haifa.

feedback.he: זה תנאי ראשון: משהו שעדיין יכול לקרות.
feedback.en: This is the first conditional: something that can still happen.

options.text: If Noa won the scholarship, she would study in Haifa.

feedback.he: זה תנאי שני: דמיון על ההווה או העתיד.
feedback.en: This is the second conditional: imagining the present or future.

options.text: If Noa wins the scholarship, she would study in Haifa.

feedback.he: המשפט מערבב סוגים: wins עם would. וגם הוא לא מדבר על העבר.
feedback.en: This mixes types: wins with would. It is also not about the past.

hints.he: לחפש את המשפט עם had.
hints.en: Look for the sentence with had.

hints.he: עבר שלא קרה: If + had + V3, would have + V3.
hints.en: An unreal past: If + had + V3, would have + V3.

explanation.he: תנאי שלישי מדבר על עבר שלא קרה ואי אפשר לשנות: If she had won, she would have studied. נועה לא זכתה במלגה, וזה כבר מאחוריה.
explanation.en: The third conditional is about a past that did not happen: If she had won, she would have studied. She did not win.

items.prompt: Omer's family lives in Eilat. If they ___ near us, Omer could join our basketball team.
items.audioText: Omer's family lives in Eilat. If they lived near us, Omer could join our basketball team.

feedback.he: live מתאים לתנאי אמיתי עם will. כאן יש could ומצב לא אמיתי: הם גרים באילת.
feedback.en: live goes with will (real). Here we have could and an unreal situation: they live in Eilat.

feedback.he: אחרי if לא שמים will.
feedback.en: No will after if.

feedback.he: would בא רק בחלק של התוצאה, לא אחרי if.
feedback.en: would goes only in the result part, not after if.

hints.he: הם באמת גרים לידנו?
hints.en: Do they really live near us?

hints.he: מצב לא אמיתי בהווה: if + עבר פשוט.
hints.en: Unreal present: if + past simple.

explanation.he: המשפחה גרה באילת, אז 'אם הם היו גרים לידנו' זה דמיון. תנאי שני: if + עבר פשוט (lived), ובחלק השני would או could + פועל.
explanation.en: They live in Eilat, so this is imaginary. Second conditional: if + past simple (lived), then would/could + verb.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: If the bus is late again, I'll take a taxi.
If the bus will be late again, I'll take a taxi.

feedback.he: אחרי if לא שמים will, גם כשמדברים על העתיד.
feedback.en: No will after if, even about the future.

options.text: If the bus is late again, I would take a taxi.

feedback.he: is עם would מערבב תנאי אמיתי ודמיוני. מצב אמיתי: will.
feedback.en: is with would mixes real and unreal. Real situation: will.

options.text: If the bus late again, I'll take a taxi.

feedback.he: חסר פועל: the bus is late.
feedback.en: The verb is missing: the bus is late.

hints.he: לבדוק את הפועל אחרי if ואת הפועל בחלק השני.
hints.en: Check the verb after if and the verb in the other part.

hints.he: תנאי אמיתי: if + הווה, ובחלק השני will.
hints.en: Real condition: if + present, then will.

explanation.he: זה מצב שבאמת יכול לקרות, לכן תנאי ראשון: If the bus is late, I'll (I will) take a taxi. בעברית אומרים 'אם האוטובוס יאחר' בעתיד, אבל באנגלית אחרי if בא הווה.
explanation.en: This can really happen, so first conditional: if + present (is), then will ('ll).

items.prompt: Last year our class trip to the Golan was cancelled because of the rain. If it ___, we would have gone.
items.audioText: Last year our class trip to the Golan was cancelled because of the rain. If it hadn't rained, we would have gone.

feedback.he: didn't rain מתאים לתנאי שני (would + פועל). כאן החלק השני הוא would have gone, עבר.
feedback.en: didn't rain goes with would + verb. Here the result is would have gone, the past.

feedback.he: would לא בא אחרי if.
feedback.en: would does not go after if.

feedback.he: doesn't rain זה הווה. הטיול היה בשנה שעברה.
feedback.en: doesn't rain is present. The trip was last year.

hints.he: מתי היה הטיול? מה מופיע בחלק השני?
hints.en: When was the trip? What is in the other part?

hints.he: would have gone דורש בחלק של if את had + V3.
hints.en: would have gone needs had + V3 after if.

explanation.he: הגשם ירד בעבר, והטיול בוטל. זה עבר שאי אפשר לשנות, לכן תנאי שלישי: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone.
explanation.en: The rain and the cancellation are in the past. Third conditional: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone.

items.prompt: I didn't sleep at all last night. If I ___ to bed earlier, I wouldn't be so tired now.
items.audioText: I didn't sleep at all last night. If I had gone to bed earlier, I wouldn't be so tired now.

feedback.he: would לא בא אחרי if, גם לא would have.
feedback.en: would never goes after if, not even would have.

feedback.he: have gone בלי had הוא הווה מושלם. אחרי if על העבר: had gone.
feedback.en: have gone is present perfect. For the past after if: had gone.

feedback.he: go זה הווה. השינה הייתה אתמול בלילה.
feedback.en: go is present. The night was last night.

hints.he: ה־if מדבר על אתמול בלילה, והתוצאה על עכשיו.
hints.en: The if part is about last night. The result is about now.

hints.he: עבר שלא קרה אחרי if: had + V3.
hints.en: Unreal past after if: had + V3.

explanation.he: זה תנאי מעורב: הסיבה בעבר (אתמול בלילה), והתוצאה בהווה (now). לכן if + had gone, ובחלק השני wouldn't be.
explanation.en: A mixed conditional: past cause (had gone) and present result (wouldn't be now).

items.prompt: If you ___ this button, the screen turns off. (press)
items.audioText: If you press this button, the screen turns off.

feedback.he: אחרי if לא שמים will.
feedback.en: No will after if.

feedback.he: החלק השני בהווה (turns off). זה כלל קבוע, אז גם אחרי if הווה.
feedback.en: The other part is present (turns off). For a fixed rule, use the present after if too.

feedback.he: עם you לא מוסיפים s.
feedback.en: No -s with you.

hints.he: לבדוק את הפועל בחלק השני: turns off.
hints.en: Look at the verb in the other part: turns off.

hints.he: כלל קבוע: הווה פשוט בשני החלקים.
hints.en: A fixed rule: present simple in both parts.

explanation.he: כך המכשיר עובד תמיד, לכן הווה פשוט בשני החלקים: If you press, the screen turns off. עם you הפועל בלי s.
explanation.en: This is how the device always works, so present simple in both parts: If you press, it turns off.

items.prompt: Hurry up! If we ___ now, we'll miss the start of the film. (not leave)
items.audioText: Hurry up! If we don't leave now, we'll miss the start of the film.

feedback.he: אחרי if לא שמים will, גם לא won't. משתמשים ב־don't.
feedback.en: No will or won't after if. Use don't.

feedback.he: didn't leave מתאים ל־would. כאן החלק השני הוא we'll miss.
feedback.en: didn't leave goes with would. Here the result is we'll miss.

feedback.he: באנגלית צריך don't לפני not: we don't leave.
feedback.en: English needs don't: we don't leave.

hints.he: בחלק השני יש we'll. איזה תנאי זה?
hints.en: The other part has we'll. Which conditional is it?

hints.he: תנאי ראשון: if + הווה פשוט בשלילה.
hints.en: First conditional: if + negative present simple.

explanation.he: מצב אמיתי שעלול לקרות, לכן תנאי ראשון: if + הווה פשוט, ובחלק השני will. בשלילה בהווה: we don't leave. בעברית 'אם לא נצא' בעתיד, אבל באנגלית אחרי if בא הווה.
explanation.en: A real possibility: first conditional. If + present simple (don't leave), then will ('ll).

items.prompt: It's only a dream, but if I ___ a famous singer, I would perform at Caesarea. (be)
items.audioText: It's only a dream, but if I were a famous singer, I would perform at Caesarea.

feedback.he: am מתאים למצב אמיתי עם will. כאן זה רק חלום, ויש would.
feedback.en: am is for real situations with will. Here it is a dream, with would.

feedback.he: would לא בא אחרי if.
feedback.en: would does not go after if.

feedback.he: אחרי if לא שמים will.
feedback.en: No will after if.

hints.he: It's only a dream: מצב אמיתי או דמיוני?
hints.en: It's only a dream: real or imaginary?

hints.he: מצב דמיוני בהווה: if + עבר פשוט.
hints.en: Imaginary present: if + past simple.

explanation.he: זה דמיון, ובחלק השני יש would, לכן תנאי שני: if + עבר. עם be משתמשים ב־were לכל הגופים (if I were). was מקובל בדיבור.
explanation.en: This is imaginary, so second conditional: if + past. With be we use were (if I were); was is fine in speech.

items.sentence: If I were you, I will apologize to Yael before the trip.
items.corrected: If I were you, I would apologize to Yael before the trip.
items.audioText: If I were you, I would apologize to Yael before the trip.
items.meaning: במקומך הייתי מתנצל/ת בפני יעל לפני הטיול.

instruction.he: למצוא את המילה השגויה ולתקן אותה
instruction.en: Find the wrong word and fix it

hints.he: If I were you הוא תנאי אמיתי או דמיוני?
hints.en: Is If I were you real or imaginary?

hints.he: מה בא בחלק השני של תנאי דמיוני?
hints.en: What goes in the result part of an imaginary condition?

explanation.he: If I were you הוא תמיד דמיון, כי אי אפשר להיות מישהו אחר. בתנאי שני החלק השני הוא would + פועל. לכן I would apologize, ולא will. זו הדרך הרגילה לתת עצה באנגלית.
explanation.en: If I were you is always imaginary. The result part needs would + verb: I would apologize.

items.sentence: Plants grow faster if they would get more sunlight.
items.corrected: Plants grow faster if they get more sunlight.
items.audioText: Plants grow faster if they get more sunlight.
items.meaning: צמחים גדלים מהר יותר אם הם מקבלים יותר אור שמש.

instruction.he: למצוא את המילה השגויה ולתקן אותה
instruction.en: Find the wrong word and fix it

hints.he: לבדוק את המילים שאחרי if.
hints.en: Check the words after if.

hints.he: זו עובדה מדעית. איזה זמן בא בשני החלקים?
hints.en: This is a science fact. Which tense goes in both parts?

explanation.he: זו עובדה שתמיד נכונה, לכן הווה פשוט בשני החלקים: grow ... get. would לא בא אחרי if בכלל. מוחקים אותו: if they get more sunlight.
explanation.en: A fact that is always true: present simple in both parts. would never goes after if, so delete it.

items.prompt: Build the sentence
items.answer: If you need help, call me.
alternatives: Call me if you need help.
items.audioText: If you need help, call me.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: המשפט מתחיל ב־If
hints.en: It starts with "If"

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If you need
hints.en: The first half: If you need

explanation.he: אפשר לבנות תנאי עם ציווי בחלק השני: If you need help, call me. אחרי if בא הווה פשוט. אפשר גם להתחיל בציווי: Call me if you need help. כשמתחילים ב־if שמים פסיק.
explanation.en: A condition can have an imperative result: If you need help, call me. After if use the present simple.

items.prompt: If you ___ sunscreen at the Dead Sea, you'll get a sunburn.
items.audioText: If you don't wear sunscreen at the Dead Sea, you'll get a sunburn.

feedback.he: לפני not צריך פועל עזר: don't wear.
feedback.en: not needs a helping verb: don't wear.

feedback.he: would לא בא אחרי if.
feedback.en: would does not go after if.

feedback.he: didn't wear מתאים ל־would. כאן החלק השני הוא you'll get.
feedback.en: didn't wear goes with would. The result here is you'll get.

hints.he: מה יש בחלק השני? you'll get.
hints.en: Look at the other part: you'll get.

hints.he: תנאי ראשון: אחרי if הווה פשוט.
hints.en: First conditional: present simple after if.

explanation.he: מצב אמיתי שיכול לקרות, לכן תנאי ראשון: If you don't wear ..., you'll get. אחרי if בא הווה פשוט, גם כשמדברים על העתיד.
explanation.en: A real possibility: first conditional. If + present simple (don't wear), then will ('ll).

items.prompt: We'll miss the beginning of the match ___ we leave right now.
items.audioText: We'll miss the beginning of the match unless we leave right now.

feedback.he: if נותן משמעות הפוכה: נפספס אם נצא עכשיו? זה לא הגיוני.
feedback.en: if gives the opposite meaning: we'll miss it if we leave now? That makes no sense.

feedback.he: when לא הגיוני כאן: נפספס כשנצא?
feedback.en: when makes no sense here.

feedback.he: so פירושו 'לכן', וזה לא מתאים כאן.
feedback.en: so means 'therefore'. It does not fit.

hints.he: נפספס את המשחק אם נצא עכשיו, או אם לא נצא?
hints.en: Will we miss it if we leave now, or if we don't?

hints.he: צריך מילה שפירושה 'אלא אם'.
hints.en: You need a word that means 'if ... not'.

explanation.he: unless = אלא אם כן, כלומר if ... not. נפספס את ההתחלה אם לא נצא עכשיו: unless we leave right now. אחרי unless, כמו אחרי if, בא הווה פשוט.
explanation.en: unless means if ... not. We'll miss it if we don't leave now. Use the present simple after unless.

items.prompt: If Yonatan passes his driving test, he ___ drive us to the Kinneret.
items.audioText: If Yonatan passes his driving test, he can drive us to the Kinneret.

feedback.he: לא שמים שני מודאלים יחד. אפשר can או will be able to.
feedback.en: Two modals cannot go together. Use can or will be able to.

feedback.he: אחרי מודאלי לא שמים to.
feedback.en: No to after a modal.

feedback.he: למודאלים אין s, גם עם he.
feedback.en: Modals never take -s, even with he.

hints.he: איך אומרים 'יוכל' בלי לשים שני מודאלים יחד?
hints.en: How do you say 'will be able' without two modals?

hints.he: בתנאי ראשון אפשר can במקום will.
hints.en: In the first conditional you can use can instead of will.

explanation.he: בחלק השני של תנאי ראשון אפשר גם can + פועל: he can drive. will can זה שני מודאלים, וזה אסור. אם רוצים will, אומרים he will be able to drive.
explanation.en: In the result part you can use can + verb. will can is two modals, which is wrong.

items.prompt: If you ___ Noa at the mall, tell her to call me.
items.audioText: If you see Noa at the mall, tell her to call me.

feedback.he: אחרי if לא שמים will.
feedback.en: No will after if.

feedback.he: would לא בא אחרי if.
feedback.en: would does not go after if.

feedback.he: seeing לבד הוא לא פועל שלם.
feedback.en: seeing alone is not a full verb.

hints.he: איזו מילה באה ממש לפני הרווח?
hints.en: Which word comes right before the gap?

hints.he: אחרי if בא הווה פשוט.
hints.en: After if use the present simple.

explanation.he: בחלק השני יש ציווי (tell her), ובחלק של if בא הווה פשוט: If you see Noa. בעברית משתמשים כאן בעתיד, ובאנגלית בהווה.
explanation.en: The result is an imperative (tell her). After if use the present simple: If you see.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: If Itai doesn't hurry, he'll miss the last bus to Haifa.
If Itai don't hurry, he'll miss the last bus to Haifa.

feedback.he: עם Itai (הוא) משתמשים ב־doesn't.
feedback.en: With Itai (he) use doesn't.

options.text: If Itai doesn't hurry, he'll missing the last bus to Haifa.

feedback.he: אחרי will בא פועל נקי, בלי ing.
feedback.en: After will use the base verb, no -ing.

options.text: If Itai doesn't hurry, he would miss the last bus to Haifa.

feedback.he: doesn't עם would מערבב סוגים. מצב אמיתי: will.
feedback.en: doesn't with would mixes types. Real situation: will.

hints.he: לבדוק את שני החלקים של כל משפט.
hints.en: Check both parts of each sentence.

hints.he: תנאי ראשון: if + הווה פשוט, will + פועל נקי.
hints.en: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb.

explanation.he: תנאי ראשון: If Itai doesn't hurry (הווה פשוט, he = doesn't), he'll miss (will + פועל נקי). כל שאר המשפטים שוברים אחד מהחוקים.
explanation.en: First conditional: if + present simple (doesn't hurry), then will + base verb (he'll miss).

items.prompt: What ___ you do if the teacher gives us a surprise quiz tomorrow?
items.audioText: What will you do if the teacher gives us a surprise quiz tomorrow?

feedback.he: would מתאים ל־if + עבר (gave). כאן מופיע gives, מצב אמיתי.
feedback.en: would goes with if + past (gave). Here it is gives, a real situation.

feedback.he: are you do לא קיים. צריך עזר של עתיד.
feedback.en: are you do is not English.

feedback.he: did זה עבר, אבל מדובר על מחר.
feedback.en: did is past, but this is about tomorrow.

hints.he: איזה זמן יש אחרי if: gives או gave?
hints.en: Which tense is after if: gives or gave?

hints.he: if + הווה הולך עם will.
hints.en: if + present goes with will.

explanation.he: אחרי if מופיע gives, הווה פשוט, וזה מחר: מצב אמיתי. לכן בשאלה משתמשים ב־will: What will you do? אם היה מופיע gave, היינו בוחרים would.
explanation.en: gives is present simple, a real future situation, so will: What will you do?

items.prompt: If we don't book the hostel in Eilat today, there ___ any rooms left.
items.audioText: If we don't book the hostel in Eilat today, there won't be any rooms left.

feedback.he: wouldn't מתאים ל־if + עבר. כאן don't book, מצב אמיתי.
feedback.en: wouldn't goes with if + past. Here it is don't book, a real situation.

feedback.he: aren't be לא קיים באנגלית.
feedback.en: aren't be is not English.

feedback.he: הסדר הוא will not (won't), לא not will.
feedback.en: The order is will not (won't).

hints.he: החלק של if בהווה. מה בא בחלק השני?
hints.en: The if part is present. What goes in the other part?

hints.he: מה השלילה של will?
hints.en: What is the negative of will?

explanation.he: If we don't book (הווה) הוא תנאי ראשון, לכן בחלק השני will. בשלילה: won't be. כך: there won't be any rooms left.
explanation.en: First conditional: if + present, then will. Negative: won't be.

items.prompt: If you ___ your Rav-Kav, you'll have to pay for a ticket. (forget)
items.audioText: If you forget your Rav-Kav, you'll have to pay for a ticket.

feedback.he: אחרי if לא שמים will.
feedback.en: No will after if.

feedback.he: forgot מתאים ל־would. כאן החלק השני הוא you'll have to.
feedback.en: forgot goes with would. The result here is you'll have to.

items.prompt: Our school doesn't have a pool. If it had one, we ___ swim during PE.

feedback.he: can מתאים למצב אמיתי. כאן if it had, דמיון, אז could.
feedback.en: can is for real situations. Here if it had is imaginary, so could.

feedback.he: will מתאים ל־if + הווה. כאן had, עבר דמיוני.
feedback.en: will goes with if + present. Here had is imaginary past.

feedback.he: we had swim לא נכון. צריך מודאלי + פועל.
feedback.en: we had swim is wrong. Use a modal + verb.

hints.he: יש לבית הספר בריכה?
hints.en: Does the school have a pool?

hints.he: בתנאי שני: would או could + פועל.
hints.en: Second conditional: would or could + verb.

explanation.he: אין בריכה, אז זה דמיון: If it had one (עבר). בחלק השני would או could. could = 'היינו יכולים'.
explanation.en: There is no pool, so this is imaginary. Result: would/could + verb. could = would be able to.

items.prompt: Where would you live if you ___ choose any city in the world?
items.audioText: Where would you live if you could choose any city in the world?

feedback.he: can מתאים ל־will. בשאלה יש would, לכן could.
feedback.en: can goes with will. The question has would, so could.

feedback.he: אחרי if לא שמים will.
feedback.en: No will after if.

feedback.he: would כבר נמצא בחלק הראשון, ולא בא אחרי if.
feedback.en: would is already in the result part. It does not go after if.

hints.he: בשאלה יש would. איזה תנאי זה?
hints.en: The question has would. Which conditional?

hints.he: אחרי if בתנאי שני: עבר. מה העבר של can?
hints.en: After if in the second conditional: past. What is the past of can?

explanation.he: would live מראה שזה תנאי שני, דמיון. אחרי if בא עבר, והעבר של can הוא could: if you could choose.
explanation.en: would shows the second conditional. After if use the past: could.

items.prompt: Tamar doesn't speak Arabic. If she ___ Arabic, she would chat with the new neighbours every day.
items.audioText: Tamar doesn't speak Arabic. If she spoke Arabic, she would chat with the new neighbours every day.

feedback.he: speaks מתאים ל־will. כאן she would chat, ותמר לא דוברת ערבית.
feedback.en: speaks goes with will. Here it is would chat, and she does not speak Arabic.

feedback.he: would לא בא אחרי if.
feedback.en: would does not go after if.

feedback.he: has spoken לא מתאים לתנאי.
feedback.en: has spoken does not fit a conditional.

hints.he: תמר באמת דוברת ערבית?
hints.en: Does Tamar really speak Arabic?

hints.he: מצב לא אמיתי בהווה: if + עבר פשוט.
hints.en: Unreal present: if + past simple.

explanation.he: תמר לא דוברת ערבית, אז זה מצב לא אמיתי בהווה. תנאי שני: if + עבר (spoke), ואחר כך would + פועל. העבר כאן לא מדבר על אתמול, הוא מסמן דמיון.
explanation.en: She doesn't speak Arabic, so this is unreal. Second conditional: if + past (spoke), would + verb. The past shows imagination, not time.

items.prompt: The kitchen smells of cake. Mom ___ baked something while we were out.

hints.en: When did she bake? Now or before?

hints.he: מסקנה על העבר: must have + V3.
hints.en: A conclusion about the past: must have + V3.

explanation.he: הריח הוא סימן, והאפייה הייתה בעבר (while we were out). מסקנה בטוחה על העבר: must have + V3: must have baked.

items.prompt: Ron ___ seen the new superhero movie already. It only opens in cinemas tomorrow!

hints.en: Is the movie out yet?

hints.en: Impossible in the past: can't have + V3.

explanation.en: never makes the sentence negative, so the tag is positive: does he?

items.prompt: Pass me the hummus, ___?
items.audioText: Pass me the hummus, will you?

feedback.he: אחרי ציווי לא משתמשים ב־do you. אומרים will you.
feedback.en: After an imperative, don't use do you. Use will you.

feedback.he: אין are במשפט. אחרי ציווי: will you.
feedback.en: There is no are. After an imperative: will you.

feedback.he: shall we בא אחרי Let's, לא אחרי ציווי רגיל.
feedback.en: shall we goes after Let's, not after a normal imperative.

hints.he: המשפט הוא ציווי, בקשה.
hints.en: The sentence is an imperative, a request.

hints.he: אחרי ציווי ה־tag בנוי ממודאלי של בקשה + you.
hints.en: After an imperative the tag is a request modal + you.

explanation.he: אחרי ציווי (Pass me...) ה־tag הוא will you? (אפשר גם would you או could you). כך הבקשה נשמעת רכה יותר. אחרי Let's בא shall we.
explanation.en: After an imperative the tag is will you? (also would / could you). After Let's use shall we.

items.prompt: The concert was amazing, ___?
items.audioText: The concert was amazing, wasn't it?

feedback.he: במשפט יש was, אז חוזרים על was.
feedback.en: The sentence has was, so repeat was.

feedback.he: המשפט בעבר (was). ה־tag בעבר.
feedback.en: The sentence is past (was). The tag is past too.

feedback.he: ב־tag לא חוזרים על השם. משתמשים בכינוי: it.
feedback.en: Don't repeat the noun in the tag. Use a pronoun: it.

hints.he: איזה פועל יש במשפט, ובאיזה זמן?
hints.en: Which verb is in the sentence? Which tense?

hints.he: חוזרים על פועל העזר באותו זמן, בשלילה.
hints.en: Repeat the helping verb in the same tense, negative.

explanation.he: ה־tag חוזר על אותו פועל עזר ובאותו זמן: was → wasn't. במקום the concert שמים it: wasn't it?
explanation.en: Repeat was in the negative and use it for the concert: wasn't it?

items.prompt: Yael has finished her project, ___ she?
items.audioText: Yael has finished her project, hasn't she?

feedback.he: במשפט יש has (הווה מושלם), אז חוזרים על has.
feedback.en: The sentence has has (present perfect), so repeat has.

feedback.he: המשפט חיובי, אז ה־tag שלילי.
feedback.en: The sentence is positive, so the tag is negative.

feedback.he: finished כאן הוא V3 אחרי has. חוזרים על has.
feedback.en: finished is V3 after has. Repeat has.

feedback.he: אין is במשפט. חוזרים על has.
feedback.en: There is no is. Repeat has.

hints.he: איזה פועל עזר יש במשפט?
hints.en: Which helping verb is in the sentence?

hints.he: חוזרים על פועל העזר והופכים לשלילה.
hints.en: Repeat the helping verb and make it negative.

explanation.he: has finished הוא הווה מושלם. ה־tag חוזר על has והופך לשלילה: hasn't she?
explanation.en: Present perfect with has: the tag is hasn't she?

items.prompt: We shouldn't tell Mom about the broken vase, ___ we?
items.audioText: We shouldn't tell Mom about the broken vase, should we?

feedback.he: המשפט שלילי, אז ה־tag חיובי.
feedback.en: The sentence is negative, so the tag is positive.

feedback.he: במשפט יש should, אז חוזרים על should.
feedback.en: The sentence has should, so repeat should.

feedback.he: חוזרים על should, לא על do.
feedback.en: Repeat should, not do.

hints.he: המשפט חיובי או שלילי?
hints.en: Is the sentence positive or negative?

hints.he: שלילי → tag חיובי עם אותו מודאלי.
hints.en: Negative → positive tag with the same modal.

explanation.he: shouldn't = שלילה. ה־tag חוזר על should בחיוב: should we?
explanation.en: Negative with shouldn't, so a positive tag: should we?

items.prompt: Everyone enjoyed the trip to the Golan, ___ they?
items.audioText: Everyone enjoyed the trip to the Golan, didn't they?

feedback.he: המשפט חיובי, אז ה־tag שלילי.
feedback.en: The sentence is positive, so the tag is negative.

feedback.he: enjoyed בעבר, אז ה־tag בעבר: didn't.
feedback.en: enjoyed is past, so the tag is past: didn't.

feedback.he: אין was במשפט. בעבר פשוט העזר הוא did.
feedback.en: There is no was. The past simple helper is did.

feedback.he: enjoyed בעבר. צריך didn't.
feedback.en: enjoyed is past. Use didn't.

hints.he: באיזה זמן הפועל enjoyed?
hints.en: Which tense is enjoyed?

hints.he: בעבר פשוט העזר הוא did.
hints.en: The past simple helper is did.

explanation.he: enjoyed בעבר פשוט, לכן העזר did, ובשלילה didn't. עם everyone ו־someone משתמשים ב־they ב־tag.
explanation.en: Past simple → did. Positive sentence → didn't. everyone takes they in the tag.

items.prompt: The bus won't be late again, ___ it?
items.audioText: The bus won't be late again, will it?

feedback.he: המשפט שלילי (won't), אז ה־tag חיובי.
feedback.en: The sentence is negative (won't), so the tag is positive.

feedback.he: במשפט יש will, אז חוזרים על will.
feedback.en: The sentence has will, so repeat will.

feedback.he: חוזרים על will, לא על does.
feedback.en: Repeat will, not does.

hints.he: won't = will not. המשפט חיובי או שלילי?
hints.en: won't = will not. Positive or negative?

hints.he: שלילי → tag חיובי.
hints.en: Negative → positive tag.

explanation.he: won't = will not, משפט שלילי. ה־tag חוזר על will בחיוב: will it?
explanation.en: won't is negative, so the tag is positive: will it?

items.sentence: Maya lives near the school, doesn't Maya?
items.corrected: Maya lives near the school, doesn't she?
items.audioText: Maya lives near the school, doesn't she?
items.meaning: מאיה גרה ליד בית הספר, נכון?

instruction.he: למצוא את המילה השגויה ולתקן אותה
instruction.en: Find the wrong word and fix it

hints.he: לבדוק את סוף המשפט.
hints.en: Check the end of the sentence.

hints.he: ב־tag משתמשים בכינוי גוף, לא בשם.
hints.en: The tag uses a pronoun, not a name.

explanation.he: ב־question tag לא חוזרים על השם. מחליפים אותו בכינוי גוף: Maya → she. doesn't she?
explanation.en: Don't repeat the name in the tag. Use a pronoun: doesn't she?

items.sentence: You've been to Masada, didn't you?
items.corrected: You've been to Masada, haven't you?
items.audioText: You've been to Masada, haven't you?

instruction.he: למצוא את המילה השגויה ולתקן אותה
instruction.en: Find the wrong word and fix it

hints.he: מה מסתתר ב־You've?
hints.en: What does You've stand for?

hints.he: חוזרים על פועל העזר של המשפט.
hints.en: Repeat the helping verb of the sentence.

explanation.he: You've = You have (הווה מושלם). ה־tag חוזר על have בשלילה: haven't you? did מתאים רק לעבר פשוט.
explanation.en: You've = You have, so the tag is haven't you? did is only for the past simple.

items.prompt: Build the sentence
items.answer: You aren't afraid of spiders, are you?
items.audioText: You aren't afraid of spiders, are you?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: המשפט מתחיל ב־You
hints.en: It starts with "You"

hints.he: החצי הראשון: You aren't afraid of
hints.en: The first half: You aren't afraid of

explanation.he: משפט שלילי (aren't) מקבל tag חיובי: are you? שואלים כך כשחושבים שהתשובה היא 'לא'.
explanation.en: A negative sentence (aren't) takes a positive tag: are you?

items.prompt: Last month, Gal said, "I'll bring the speaker tomorrow." → Gal said he would bring the speaker ___.
items.audioText: Last month, Gal said, "I'll bring the speaker tomorrow." Gal said he would bring the speaker the next day.

feedback.he: גל אמר את זה לפני חודש. ה'מחר' שלו כבר עבר: the next day.
feedback.en: Gal said it a month ago. His 'tomorrow' has passed: the next day.

feedback.he: yesterday הפוך: מדובר על היום שאחרי.
feedback.en: yesterday is the opposite: it's the day after.

feedback.he: the day before = יום קודם. גל דיבר על היום שאחרי.
feedback.en: the day before is the wrong day. Gal meant the day after.

hints.he: מתי גל אמר את זה?
hints.en: When did Gal say it?

hints.he: tomorrow בדיבור עקיף על העבר הופך ל־...
hints.en: In reported speech about the past, tomorrow becomes...

explanation.he: כשמדווחים על משהו שנאמר מזמן, מילות הזמן משתנות: tomorrow → the next day (או the following day), today → that day, yesterday → the day before.
explanation.en: When reporting later, time words change: tomorrow → the next day.

items.prompt: "Please close the windows," the teacher said. → The teacher asked us ___ the windows.
items.audioText: The teacher asked us to close the windows.

feedback.he: אחרי asked us צריך to + פועל.
feedback.en: After asked us use to + verb.

feedback.he: asked us closing לא נכון. צריך to close.
feedback.en: asked us closing is wrong. Use to close.

feedback.he: בקשה מדווחים עם to + פועל, לא עם that.
feedback.en: Report a request with to + verb, not that.

hints.he: זו בקשה. איך מדווחים בקשה?
hints.en: It's a request. How do you report a request?

hints.he: asked / told + מישהו + to + פועל.
hints.en: asked / told + person + to + verb.

explanation.he: בקשות וציוויים מדווחים עם asked/told + מישהו + to + פועל: The teacher asked us to close the windows.
explanation.en: Report requests and commands with asked/told + person + to + verb.

items.prompt: "Don't be late for the bus," the guide told us. → The guide told us ___ late for the bus.
items.audioText: The guide told us not to be late for the bus.

feedback.he: בדיווח לא משאירים את don't. משתמשים ב־not to.
feedback.en: Don't keep don't in reported speech. Use not to.

feedback.he: חסר to: not to be.
feedback.en: to is missing: not to be.

feedback.he: to don't לא קיים. אומרים not to.
feedback.en: to don't is not English. Use not to.

hints.he: זה ציווי שלילי. איך מדווחים אותו?
hints.en: It's a negative command. How do you report it?

hints.he: told + מישהו + not to + פועל.
hints.en: told + person + not to + verb.

explanation.he: ציווי שלילי (Don't...) מדווחים עם told + מישהו + not to + פועל: told us not to be late.
explanation.en: Report a negative command with told + person + not to + verb.

items.prompt: "Are you coming to the youth group tonight?" Neta asked me. → Neta asked me if ___ to the youth group that night.
items.audioText: Neta asked me if I was coming to the youth group that night.

feedback.he: בשאלה עקיפה הסדר רגיל: קודם הנושא, אחר כך הפועל.
feedback.en: In a reported question use normal order: subject, then verb.

feedback.he: זה סדר של שאלה וגם הווה. צריך I was coming.
feedback.en: This is question order and present tense. Use I was coming.

feedback.he: חסר פועל: I was coming.
feedback.en: The verb is missing: I was coming.

hints.he: מה הסדר של I ו־was?
hints.en: What is the order of I and was?

hints.he: שאלה עקיפה: if + נושא + פועל, וזמן אחד אחורה.
hints.en: Reported question: if + subject + verb, one tense back.

explanation.he: בשאלה עקיפה אין סדר של שאלה: if I was coming, לא was I. בנוסף are → was, ו־tonight → that night.
explanation.en: Reported questions use statement order (I was), and the tense moves back.

items.prompt: "Where did you buy your shoes?" Lia asked. → Lia asked me where I ___ my shoes.
items.audioText: Lia asked me where I had bought my shoes.

feedback.he: בשאלה עקיפה לא משתמשים ב־did של שאלה.
feedback.en: Reported questions don't use question did.

feedback.he: have bought לא זז אחורה. מעבר פשוט עוברים ל־had bought.
feedback.en: have bought is not moved back. Past simple → had bought.

feedback.he: buy בהווה. השאלה הייתה בעבר.
feedback.en: buy is present. The question was in the past.

hints.he: השאלה המקורית בעבר: did you buy.
hints.en: The original question is past: did you buy.

hints.he: בדיווח: בלי did, וזמן אחד אחורה.
hints.en: Reported: no did, one tense back.

explanation.he: בשאלה עקיפה מורידים את did ומשתמשים בסדר רגיל. עבר פשוט זז אחורה ל־had + V3: where I had bought. (בדיבור אפשר גם where I bought.)
explanation.en: Drop did, use statement order, and move the past back: where I had bought.

items.prompt: My grandmother ___ me how school was going.
items.audioText: My grandmother asked me how school was going.

feedback.he: said לא בא עם me ישר אחריו, ולא מדווח שאלה.
feedback.en: said doesn't take me directly, and doesn't report a question.

feedback.he: asked to me לא נכון כאן.
feedback.en: asked to me is wrong here.

feedback.he: says לא בא עם me, ולא מדווח שאלה.
feedback.en: says doesn't take me and doesn't report a question.

hints.he: how school was going היא שאלה.
hints.en: how school was going is a question.

hints.he: איזה פועל מדווח שאלה?
hints.en: Which verb reports a question?

explanation.he: כדי לדווח שאלה משתמשים ב־asked + מישהו: She asked me how... אחרי said לא בא me ישר.
explanation.en: To report a question use asked + person. said does not take me directly.

items.prompt: Last week Eden said, "I can't come to practice tomorrow." → Eden said she ___ come to practice the next day.
items.audioText: Eden said she couldn't come to practice the next day.

feedback.he: האימון כבר עבר. בדיווח can't זז אחורה ל־couldn't.
feedback.en: Practice is over. In reported speech can't → couldn't.

feedback.he: אחרי could לא שמים to.
feedback.en: No to after could.

feedback.he: can לא מקבל did. השלילה בעבר: couldn't.
feedback.en: can doesn't take did. Past negative: couldn't.

hints.he: מתי עדן אמרה את זה?
hints.en: When did Eden say it?

hints.he: בדיווח: can → could.
hints.en: Reported speech: can → could.

explanation.he: עדן דיברה בשבוע שעבר על אימון שכבר עבר, לכן הזמן זז אחורה: can't → couldn't. גם tomorrow → the next day.
explanation.en: The time has passed, so can't → couldn't (and tomorrow → the next day).

items.prompt: Itamar suggested ___ to the Dead Sea for the weekend.
items.audioText: Itamar suggested going to the Dead Sea for the weekend.

feedback.he: אחרי suggest לא בא to + פועל. צריך ing.
feedback.en: suggest is not followed by to + verb. Use -ing.

feedback.he: suggest us to go לא נכון. אומרים suggested that we go.
feedback.en: suggest us to go is wrong. Say suggested that we go.

feedback.he: אחרי that צריך משפט מלא: that we go.
feedback.en: After that you need a full clause: that we go.

hints.he: איזו צורה באה אחרי suggest?
hints.en: Which form follows suggest?

hints.he: suggest + ing, או suggest that + משפט.
hints.en: suggest + -ing, or suggest that + clause.

explanation.he: suggest הוא פועל דיווח עם מבנה מיוחד: suggested going, או suggested that we go. בעברית 'הציע ללכת', אבל באנגלית אין to אחרי suggest.
explanation.en: suggest takes -ing (suggested going) or that + clause, never to + verb.

items.prompt: "I'm nervous," Ofir said before the math bagrut last June. → Ofir said he ___ nervous.
items.audioText: Ofir said he was nervous.

feedback.he: אופיר דיבר ביוני שעבר. בדיווח am → was.
feedback.en: Ofir spoke last June. In reported speech am → was.

feedback.he: עם he משתמשים ב־was.
feedback.en: With he use was.

feedback.he: am מתאים ל־I. בדיווח: he was.
feedback.en: am is for I. Reported: he was.

hints.he: מתי אופיר אמר את זה?
hints.en: When did Ofir say it?

hints.he: בדיווח זזים זמן אחד אחורה: am → ?
hints.en: Reported speech moves one tense back: am → ?

explanation.he: אופיר דיבר בעבר, והמבחן כבר מאחוריו. לכן am זז אחורה ל־was, ו־I הופך ל־he.
explanation.en: The words were said in the past: am → was, I → he.

items.prompt: "I'll send you the photos tonight," Shira said on Sunday. → Shira said she ___ send me the photos that night.
items.audioText: Shira said she would send me the photos that night.

feedback.he: שירה דיברה ביום ראשון. בדיווח will → would.
feedback.en: Shira spoke on Sunday. Reported: will → would.

feedback.he: אחרי would לא שמים to.
feedback.en: No to after would.

feedback.he: בדיווח על העבר צריך would.
feedback.en: Reporting the past, use would.

hints.he: I'll = I will. מה קורה ל־will בדיווח?
hints.en: I'll = I will. What happens to will in reported speech?

hints.he: will זז אחורה ל־...
hints.en: will moves back to...

explanation.he: בדיווח על דברים שנאמרו בעבר, will זז אחורה ל־would. גם tonight הופך ל־that night.
explanation.en: In reported speech will → would, and tonight → that night.

items.prompt: "Turn off your phones," the guide said. → The guide told us ___ off our phones.
items.audioText: The guide told us to turn off our phones.

feedback.he: אחרי told us צריך to + פועל.
feedback.en: After told us use to + verb.

feedback.he: told us turning לא נכון. צריך to turn.
feedback.en: told us turning is wrong. Use to turn.

feedback.he: ציווי מדווחים עם to, לא עם that.
feedback.en: Report a command with to, not that.

hints.he: זה ציווי. איך מדווחים ציווי?
hints.en: It's a command. How do you report it?

hints.he: told + מישהו + to + פועל.
hints.en: told + person + to + verb.

explanation.he: ציווי מדווחים עם told + מישהו + to + פועל: told us to turn off our phones. גם your הופך ל־our.
explanation.en: Report a command with told + person + to + verb.

items.prompt: "Why are you laughing?" the teacher asked us. → The teacher asked us why we ___ laughing.
items.audioText: The teacher asked us why we were laughing.

feedback.he: השאלה נשאלה בעבר. בדיווח are → were.
feedback.en: The question was in the past. Reported: are → were.

feedback.he: עם we משתמשים ב־were.
feedback.en: With we use were.

feedback.he: בשאלה עקיפה הסדר רגיל: we were.
feedback.en: In a reported question use normal order: we were.

hints.he: באיזה זמן הפועל asked?
hints.en: Which tense is asked?

hints.he: are זז אחורה ל־...
hints.en: are moves back to...

explanation.he: asked בעבר, אז are זז אחורה ל־were. בשאלה עקיפה הסדר רגיל: why we were laughing.
explanation.en: asked is past, so are → were, with statement order: why we were laughing.

items.sentence: In June, Ido said he would call me tomorrow.
items.corrected: In June, Ido said he would call me the next day.
items.audioText: In June, Ido said he would call me the next day.
items.meaning: ביוני עידו אמר שהוא יתקשר אליי למחרת.

instruction.he: למצוא את המילה השגויה ולתקן אותה
instruction.en: Find the wrong word and fix it

hints.he: מתי עידו אמר את זה?
hints.en: When did Ido say it?

hints.he: לבדוק את מילת הזמן בסוף.
hints.en: Check the time word at the end.

explanation.he: עידו דיבר ביוני, אז ה'מחר' שלו היה מזמן. בדיווח tomorrow הופך ל־the next day (או the following day).
explanation.en: He spoke in June, so tomorrow becomes the next day.

items.sentence: The coach told us don't stop running.
items.corrected: The coach told us not to stop running.
items.audioText: The coach told us not to stop running.
items.meaning: המאמן אמר לנו לא להפסיק לרוץ.

instruction.he: למצוא את המילה השגויה ולתקן אותה
instruction.en: Find the wrong word and fix it

hints.he: לבדוק את המילה שאחרי told us.
hints.en: Check the word after told us.

hints.he: ציווי שלילי בדיווח: told us + ? + פועל.
hints.en: Reported negative command: told us + ? + verb.

explanation.he: ציווי שלילי (Don't stop) מדווחים עם not to + פועל: told us not to stop running.
explanation.en: Report a negative command with not to + verb.

items.prompt: Build the sentence
items.answer: Grandpa asked me what I wanted for my birthday.
alternatives: For my birthday, Grandpa asked me what I wanted.
items.audioText: Grandpa asked me what I wanted for my birthday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: המשפט מתחיל ב־Grandpa
hints.en: It starts with "Grandpa"
